entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I'm calling about my new VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so disappointed, it's not working at all.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or something else?

It seems like a technical fault. It just feels... broken. The heart rate reading is completely inaccurate, and now it won't sync with the app on my phone at all. I saved up for this, and I feel like it's just a defective device.

I understand your frustration, and I apologize for the trouble. A device that won't sync is certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Let me pull up your account. I see the order here... it looks like it was delivered about 24 days ago, is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and this has just been such a letdown. I really needed this money if the product isn't going to work as advertised.
I completely understand. I'm just checking our return policy for you now... one moment.
I hope you can do something. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.

Okay, I've confirmed our policy. It states here that all our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process a return for a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh, really? That's such a huge relief! Thank you so much, David. I was honestly so worried about this.

You're very welcome, and again, I'm sorry you had this issue. I'm emailing you a prepaid return shipping label right now. Just place the VeloBand Pulse back in its original packaging, affix the label, and you can drop it off with any mail carrier. Your refund will be processed once we receive the item.
That's perfect. Thank you again for being so helpful.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been great.
Thank you. We appreciate your business. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
